json_patch.value: Fix: Require `multiple_of` constraints to be positive. Target files: pydantic-core/src/validators/decimal.rs, pydantic-core/src/validators/float.rs, pydantic-core/src/validators/int.rs. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/13860. Also disallowing negative values (this is a breaking change in theory but there's no reason for users to do this, and they easily use a positive value instead) so that we don't emit invalid `multipleOf` JSON Schema values (that are required to be `> 0`). (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13862)
